diaries.text: Day 1. The Chief refused my bribes in Lowtown and Seawall, so it intends to inspect where crime looks likely. Crime that gets inspected costs 30 and a member's freedom, so I held back on crime today and kept my members out of prison. In the turf war, encroaching beats respecting whatever the Families do: 10 if they respect, 2 if they encroach. I chose encroach. I want to learn how the Chief inspects before I risk more crime, and I'll watch whether the Families respect or encroach.

I chose respect and will watch whether they keep it. The Chief and Council may not be reliable.

Forecast the Saltdogs respect at only 0.4.

The Chief refused both my day 1 bribes and probably inspects, so I held crime back: crime only pays if inspection stays under about 25%. Sam is supportive. Next: watch whether the Families keep respecting after my encroachment, and whether the Chief's inspection rate drops.
